name: Scream Tail
description: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

moves.name: Pound
moves.description: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.

moves.name: Sing
moves.description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a beautiful voice that puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Disable
moves.description: For four turns, the target will be unable to use whichever move it last used.

moves.name: Howl
moves.description: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.

moves.name: Noble Roar
moves.description: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.

moves.name: Psychic Fangs
moves.description: The user attacks by biting the target with its psychic capabilities. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Wish
moves.description: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Perish Song
moves.description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

moves.name: Boomburst
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with a fiery punch. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with an icy punch. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Roar
moves.description: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to damage all Pokémon except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.description: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Thunder Fang
moves.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

moves.name: Fire Fang
moves.description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Misty Terrain
moves.description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

moves.name: Psychic Terrain
moves.description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

moves.name: Psychic Fangs
moves.description: The user attacks by biting the target with its psychic capabilities. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.description: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Misty Explosion
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is boosted on Misty Terrain.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Snowscape
moves.description: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

moves.name: Psychic Noise
moves.description: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.
